author: Heather Knight
text: Rozell’s Septic Service was amazing to work with. It’s a locally family-owned business, which we love supporting. They were on time, very professional, and explained everything clearly. The whole process was smooth and stress-free!

author: Jarod Hogan
text: Lauren and her entire team were AWESOME!  From preplanning, designing, installing, and explaining the equipment, I highly recommend Rozell's Septic Services for your next sewer/septic/aerobic system job.  My partner and I genuinely appreciate the professionalism and dedication to doing what is right for the customer.

author: Crystal Leigh
text: Great septic service! Friendly, helpful, and went above and beyond. I’m very happy with the service and highly recommend them

author: Mike Mayhugh
text: I didn't know I had busted my chlorinator pipe and clean-out pipe with my zero-turn. Frank and Lauren diagnosed the problem, made the repairs, and did so without breaking the bank. They were fast, courteous, and professional. Since I am new to aerobic systems, they gave my wife and me a great education on how to maintain and care for my equipment. They also communicated well, sending pictures of repairs, texts, and updates. I highly recommend Rozell’s for installation, repair, maintenance, and upkeep!

author: Pamela Medina
text: Rosell's came out to my place today and pumped my system and did an inspection. They were very friendly and professional. Very reasonable prices. I try to support our local businesses. I highly recommend this company and I will most definitely call them again.
